item.title: Horse Picture Books for the Year of the Horse
item.description: The Year of the Horse is here! A year said to be filled with freedom, courage, and taking risks. After the Year of the Snake (centered around focus, and steady progress) I am so excited for this change in pace and to gallop into new adventures! To ring in the new year, we wanted to share some stories about horses to get you and your young reader excited for this new energy!

item.title: Acquisition Announcement: MERCIFUL CARNAGE by Sara Hashem
item.description: Orbit is delighted to announce the acquisition of Merciful Carnage, the first book in a new dark fantasy romance duology by Sara Hashem! Tala’s life has been defined by her inability to die. Her superstitious village has treated her with distrust and hostility since she was found floating in the Liyan River as a newborn. item.title: Weird Books for Your Weird Kid
item.description: I think we can all agree on one thing—weird kids are the best! They have an ability to appreciate the wacky and absurd parts of life that many of us brush past without a second glance. And these wonderfully weird kids deserve even weirder books. If this sounds like someone you know, you’ll definitely want to take a look at these silly reads for your quirky kid!
